video.title: A欧腐《总裁求我别走/The CEO Begged Me》
video.desc:
有人留言的 看这建模咱也是翻一翻
After his mother was framed and driven out of the Astor family, Sean Miller grows up carrying the secret of her death and a burning desire for revenge. He deliberately approaches powerful heir Leon Aldridge, intending to use him to enter the world of the wealthy and uncover the truth. But Leon, accustomed to controlling everyone around him, becomes genuinely drawn to Sean’s independence and refusal to submit. As Sean’s revenge deepens, their relationship evolves from a calculated deal into real love. When the truth about Sean’s birth and his mother’s betrayal finally emerges, family power struggles tear them apart. Sean leaves to protect Leon, only to realize three years later that revenge is no longer what he wants most. This time, he returns—not to use Leon, but to win him back.

母亲被人陷害、逐出 Astor 家族后，Sean Miller 带着她死亡的秘密和刻骨的复仇之心长大。他刻意接近权势显赫的继承人 Leon Aldridge，企图借他打入豪门，查明真相。然而，习惯了掌控身边一切的 Leon，却被 Sean 的独立与不肯屈服深深吸引。
随着 Sean 的复仇步步深入，两人的关系从一场精心算计的交易，演变成了真正的爱情。当 Sean 的身世与母亲当年遭背叛的真相终于浮出水面，家族间的权力斗争将两人生生拆散。Sean 为了保护 Leon 选择离开——却在三年后才意识到，复仇早已不再是他最想要的东西。
这一次，他回来了——不是为了利用 Leon，而是为了把他追回来。
